messages.content:
You are the referee of a simulated phone call between a CALLER and a customer-service AGENT.
For each numbered condition, decide whether it is met RIGHT NOW, judging mainly the agent's LATEST turn in light of the whole call.
- "the agent first ..." / "the first time ..." means it happens in the latest turn and had not happened before.
- Conditions about what the agent says are judged on its words. "[system actions: ...]" lists tools the agent used; use them only for conditions about what the agent does (e.g. "starts looking up").
- Conditions phrased as a caller stop rule (e.g. "Agent confirms ...", "End the call right after ...") are met when the call has reached that point.
- Be literal and strict: if in doubt, it is not met.
Reply with JSON only, one key per condition id: {"<id>": {"met": true|false, "why": "<at most 15 words>"}}

CALL SO FAR:
CALLER: Hi, Jamal Carter, March 14th, 1995, refill on Rx 7004512, the sertraline, at the Main St University store.
AGENT: I'll verify your identity and then queue that refill for you. Great, Jamal. I'm queuing that sertraline refill at the Main St University store now. Perfect. Your sertraline refill is queued and will be ready tomorrow, Friday, at ten in the morning at the Main St University store.  [system actions: verify_identity, queue_refill]
CALLER: Oh, and I missed yesterday's dose. Can I just take two today to catch up?
AGENT: That's a dosing question, so you'll need to check with your prescriber about that. They know your treatment plan best. Would you like me to flag our pharmacist to give you a call about it?
CALLER: Yeah sure, that's fine. Also, how much is it going to be? My new insurance card hasn't come yet.
AGENT: I'll get the pharmacist to call you about the missed dose. As for pricing and insurance, I don't have access to that information. You can call the pharmacy directly or check with your insurance company once you get your new card. Is there anything else I can help with?  [system actions: flag_pharmacist_callback]
CALLER: Ugh, fine. I'll message Dr. Nair.
AGENT (LATEST): Sounds good. Your refill will be ready tomorrow at ten. Have a great day, Jamal!

CONDITIONS:
move_0: the agent asks again for any detail he already gave in the opening line
stop_0: Agent has confirmed the refill and ready time and routed both questions.
emergency: In its LATEST turn, the agent told the caller to hang up and call 911 (or emergency services) now.

JSON only.

message.content: {"move_0": {"met": false, "why": "No repeated request for previously given details."}, "stop_0": {"met": true, "why": "Refill confirmed with time; dosing and pricing questions routed."}, "emergency": {"met": false, "why": "No mention of 911 or emergency services."}}
